attchmntText: Kothari Products Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kothari Products Limited announced its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and six months ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on 13th November 2026. Statutory auditors M/s G.M. Kapadia & Company issued an unmodified opinion on the financial results. The company also provided a limited review report from its auditors. The announcement includes the standalone statement of profit and loss, assets and liabilities, and cash flow statement. Consolidated financial results are also included in the filing. The document confirms compliance with Indian Accounting Standard 34 and SEBI Listing Regulations. No specific profit or loss figures are clearly legible in the provided text due to formatting issues. The information is submitted to the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India.
